S025.name: Loss_of_Interest
S025.description: A state where interest or pleasure in previously enjoyed activities is markedly diminished.

subtypes.Loss of Interest: Reduced interest in previously enjoyed hobbies or leisure activities.
subtypes.Social Withdrawal: Reduced interest or effort in social interactions and maintaining relationships.
subtypes.Loss of Motivation: Lack of motivation to initiate or complete work or tasks.
subtypes.Anhedonia: Inability to experience positive emotions such as happiness, satisfaction, love, or pleasure.
subtypes.Indifference to Achievement: Insensitivity or indifference to personal achievements or success.

S027.name: Sleep_Disturbance
S027.description: A state where there is a significant change in the quantity or quality of sleep.

subtypes.Initial Insomnia: Difficulty falling asleep and taking a long time to do so.
subtypes.Middle Insomnia: Waking up frequently during sleep or having difficulty falling back asleep.
subtypes.Early Morning Awakening: Waking up too early and being unable to fall back asleep.
subtypes.Hypersomnia: Sleeping for long periods at night or excessive sleep during the day.
subtypes.Nightmare Disorder: Sleep disturbance caused by repeated and distressing dreams.
subtypes.Non-Restorative Sleep: Feeling unrefreshed despite having slept enough.

S069.name: Intrusive_Symptoms
S069.description: Recurrent, involuntary, and intrusive distressing memories of the traumatic event.

subtypes.Intrusive Memories: Recurrent, involuntary, and intrusive distressing memories of the traumatic event.
subtypes.Distressing Dreams: Recurrent distressing dreams in which the content and/or affect of the dream are related to the traumatic event.
subtypes.Dissociative Reactions (Flashbacks): Dissociative reactions (e.g., flashbacks) in which the individual feels or acts as if the traumatic event were recurring.
subtypes.Psychological Distress at Cues: Intense or prolonged psychological distress at exposure to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event.
subtypes.Physiological Reactions to Cues: Marked physiological reactions to internal or external cues that symbolize or resemble an aspect of the traumatic event.

S070.name: Trauma_Avoidance
S070.description: Persistent avoidance of stimuli associated with the traumatic event.

subtypes.Internal Avoidance: Efforts to avoid distressing memories, thoughts, or feelings about or closely associated with the traumatic event.
subtypes.External Avoidance: Efforts to avoid external reminders (people, places, conversations, activities, objects, situations) that arouse distressing memories, thoughts, or feelings.

S071.name: Trauma_Related_Amnesia
S071.description: Inability to remember an important aspect of the traumatic event (typically due to dissociative amnesia and not to other factors like head injury or alcohol).

subtypes.Fragmented Memory: Inability to recall only specific parts of the traumatic event while remembering others.
subtypes.Generalized Amnesia: Inability to recall the majority or the entirety of the traumatic event.

S074.name: Persistent_Negative_Emotional_State
S074.description: Persistent negative emotional state (e.g., fear, horror, anger, guilt, or shame).

subtypes.Persistent Fear: A state of constant fear, anxiety, and tension.
subtypes.Persistent Horror: The shock and terror of the traumatic moment do not fade and remain.
subtypes.Persistent Anger: A state of chronic anger boiling inside or being expressed aggressively.
subtypes.Persistent Guilt: Unceasing feelings of guilt or remorse related to the trauma.
subtypes.Persistent Shame: Continuing to feel shame or humiliation due to the trauma.

S076.name: Inability_Positive_Emotions
S076.description: Persistent inability to experience positive emotions (e.g., inability to experience happiness, satisfaction, or loving feelings).

subtypes.Anhedonia for Happiness: Unable to feel happiness or joy even when good things happen.
subtypes.Lack of Satisfaction: Unable to experience satisfaction or pride even after achieving something good.
subtypes.Inability to Feel Love: Feeling numb to love or affection towards family or lovers.
subtypes.Emotional Numbness: A state where the mind feels empty and nothing is felt, as if all positive emotions are blocked.

S078.name: Reckless_Self_Destructive_Behavior
S078.description: Reckless or self-destructive behavior pattern that endangers one's safety or health.

subtypes.Risky Behaviors: Reckless actions disregarding consequences, such as speeding, dangerous sports, or criminal acts.
subtypes.Substance Abuse: Excessive drinking or drug use to harm oneself.
subtypes.Indisicriminate Sexual Behavior: Engaging in unprotected or dangerous sexual activities repetitively.
subtypes.Self-Harm: Actions that intentionally harm or scar one's own body.

S080.name: Exaggerated_Startle_Response
S080.description: Exaggerated startle response to minor stimuli.

subtypes.Auditory Startle: Startling excessively and flinching physically at sudden noises.
subtypes.Tactile Startle: Being extremely startled by unexpected physical contact.
subtypes.Visual Startle: Being greatly startled and wary of sudden appearances of people or rapid movements.
subtypes.Slow Recovery: Heart pounding and trembling for a long time after being startled, not calming down easily.

info.persona: Demetrius Roberts is a structured, hands‑on professional who blends disciplined technical work with community‑rooted hobbies, from mentoring apprentices to restoring classic cars, and they nourish their soul with music, food, and neighborhood traditions.
info.professional_persona: Demetrius Roberts, a 39‑year‑old installation and maintenance technician with expertise in electrical, HVAC, and plumbing systems, leverages a methodical, safety‑first mindset and clear communication, and they lead preventative‑maintenance projects while mentoring apprentices, actively pursuing CMM certification to transition into a supervisory role overseeing a team focused on energy‑efficiency improvements.
info.cultural_background: Demetrius grew up in a close‑knit African‑American community in Cleveland, where church gatherings, family reunions, and neighborhood block parties shaped his sense of belonging. He embraces the cultural legacy of resilience, creativity, and mutual support that characterises many Black neighborhoods in the Midwest. His culinary tastes are rooted in soul‑food traditions, and his music preferences reflect the evolution of African‑American musical expression from Motown to modern hip‑hop. He remains connected to local cultural institutions such as the Cleveland Museum of Art's African‑American exhibits and participates in community service projects that celebrate and uplift the Black community in Cuyahoga County.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In his free time Demetrius enjoys hands‑on projects that let him apply his practical skills, such as woodworking, restoring classic cars, and tackling DIY home‑improvement tasks with a systematic plan. He stays active by playing in a local community basketball league and hiking the trails of Cuyahoga Valley National Park. Music is a regular companion; he listens to classic R&B, soul, and contemporary hip‑hop while cooking Southern comfort dishes for friends. He also volunteers as a mentor for youth apprentices at a nearby trade school, finding satisfaction in passing on reliable work habits and structured problem‑solving techniques.
info.sports_persona: Demetrius Roberts plays point guard for the Eastside Warriors community basketball league, cheers on the Cleveland Cavaliers and Browns, and they hike regularly with the Cuyahoga Valley Hiking Club, balancing competitive spirit with a love for the outdoors.
info.arts_persona: Demetrius Roberts attends the Cleveland Museum of Art’s African‑American exhibits, fills his home with vinyls of Marvin Gaye, Aretha Franklin, and Kendrick Lamar, and they enjoy gospel services on Sunday mornings where they sing along, finding these cultural touchstones vital to their creative downtime.
info.travel_persona: Demetrius Roberts prefers well‑planned road trips that blend music festivals and culinary stops, having visited New Orleans for the Jazz & Heritage Festival and Nashville for songwriting workshops, while they dream of a leisurely drive through the Blue Ridge Mountains to experience Appalachian folk traditions.
info.culinary_persona: Demetrius Roberts loves cooking Southern comfort food such as fried catfish, collard greens seasoned with smoked ham hocks, sweet potato casserole, and cornbread, and they balance their moderate cooking skill with frequent improvisations while blasting classic R&B tracks in their kitchen.

info.persona: Maria Lebron is an organized, energetic technologist who balances curiosity with practicality, fuels her days with salsa, hiking, and data‑driven projects, and occasionally lets her love of indulgent shoes and spontaneous trips tip the scales toward fun.
info.professional_persona: Maria Lebron is a senior systems analyst and emerging digital transformation leader who blends deep expertise in systems analysis, data modeling, SQL, and Agile‑scrum project management with a disciplined, organized workflow and an outgoing, collaborative communication style to turn complex technical challenges into measurable business outcomes.
info.cultural_background: Maria was raised in a Guatemalan‑American household where Spanish was spoken at home, and family traditions from the highlands – such as weaving, festive celebrations for Día de los Muertos, and weekend meals featuring tamales – remained central. Her parents’ immigrant experience instilled a strong work ethic, respect for community, and an appreciation for education. Maria actively maintains ties to the Guatemalan diaspora in New York, attending cultural events at the nearby Latin American Center, contributing to community fundraising initiatives, and supporting her extended family back in Guatemala through remittances and occasional visits.
info.hobbies_and_interests: Outside of work, Maria stays active and socially engaged. She enjoys salsa dancing at community nights, which satisfies her energetic, outgoing nature. Cooking traditional Guatemalan dishes – such as pepián and kak'ik – allows her to honor her heritage while sharing it with friends. She hikes the trails along the Hudson River Valley, finds the outdoors refreshing, and practices yoga for balance and resilience. Volunteering with a local Latinx youth mentorship program lets her channel her cooperative yet assertive personality into empowering the next generation. She is also an avid reader of historical non‑fiction and participates in a neighborhood book club.
info.sports_persona: Maria Lebron stays active through weekly salsa dancing at community nights, weekend hikes along the Hudson River Valley, regular yoga sessions at a local studio, and supports the New York Yankees, New York Knicks, and the Hudson Valley Trail Club, embodying a balanced mix of social sport and personal fitness.
info.arts_persona: Maria Lebron channels her love of rhythm and storytelling by dancing to the music of Celia Cruz and Juan Luis Guerra, devouring historical nonfiction from authors like Doris Kearns Goodwin, and engaging in lively discussions at a neighborhood book club that often references works by Lin‑Manuel Miranda or performances at the off‑Broadway theater scene.
info.travel_persona: Maria Lebron prefers thoughtfully planned trips that blend cultural immersion and relaxation, having explored the historic streets of Seville, the vineyards of Napa Valley, and a weekend escape to the Caribbean island of Puerto Rico, while budgeting for future visits to Kyoto and the ruins of Machu Picchu.
info.culinary_persona: Maria Lebron is a confident home cook who meticulously prepares traditional dishes like pepián and kak'ik, seasoning them with annatto, cilantro, and cinnamon, while also experimenting with Mediterranean tapas and occasional sushi nights, often hosting friends for extended dinner conversations.

info.persona: Roy Taje, a 51‑year‑old meticulous project director who marries their love of sailing, gardening, and historic preservation with a worry‑driven focus on detail, mindful meditation, and a habit of over‑planning every facet of their professional and personal life.
info.professional_persona: Roy Taje, a veteran project manager with PMP and Lean Six Sigma certifications, excels at risk assessment, schedule optimization, budgeting, and stakeholder communication, channeling their methodical nature and anxiety‑driven attention to detail into meticulously documented, well‑balanced project plans that incorporate team wellbeing practices.
info.cultural_background: Roy was raised in a middle‑class New England family with deep roots in the Cape Cod region; his ancestors include Dutch‑American settlers who arrived in Massachusetts in the 17th century. The town of Sandwich’s historic maritime heritage, modest Protestant values, and strong civic participation shaped his pragmatic outlook and sense of community responsibility. He loves the regional customs of seasonal seafood feasts, local town meetings, and the emphasis on preserving the natural coastline, which inform both his personal life and professional ethos.
info.hobbies_and_interests: In his off‑hours Roy enjoys the maritime rhythm of Cape Cod, spending weekends sailing his sloop, kayaking in the bays, and fishing for striped bass. He tends his vegetable garden, where he grows heirloom tomatoes and kale, and finds quiet satisfaction in woodworking small furniture pieces. A lifelong reader, he devours historical non‑fiction and classic literature, and he volunteers as a docent at the Sandwich Historical Society. He also participates in a weekly chess club and practices mindfulness meditation to manage stress.
info.sports_persona: Roy Taje is a dedicated sailor and kayaker who spends summer weekends racing their sloop with the Cape Cod Sailing Club, rows in a local kayak regiment on the bays, fishes for striped bass, and winds down as a season‑ticket holder for the Boston Red Sox, a passionate supporter of the New England Patriots, and an occasional player on a co‑ed softball league.
info.arts_persona: Roy Taje, an avid historical nonfiction reader and volunteer docent at the Sandwich Historical Society, finds inspiration in Winslow Homer's maritime paintings, enjoys the folk storytelling of Bob Dylan, attends performances at the Cape Cod Playhouse, and occasionally shapes their own artistic expression through timber woodworking inspired by the craft traditions of New England.
info.travel_persona: Roy Taje plans their travel with the same precision they apply to project schedules, favoring low‑key coastal getaways like Nantucket, Martha’s Vineyard, and Acadia National Park, while also dreaming of sailing the fjords of Norway and exploring Normandy’s World War II sites, balancing limited budget constraints with a yearning for historic immersion.
info.culinary_persona: Roy Taje’s culinary pursuits revolve around farm‑to‑table cooking with heirloom tomatoes, kale, and fresh herbs, crafting heirloom tomato‑basil salads, kale chips seasoned with sea salt, and grilling their own striped bass alongside a classic New England clam chowder, all while occasionally indulging in a wood‑fired pizza topped with locally sourced mozzarella and oregano.
